resources.string: Automatically unblocks every app allowed to send notifications when vivo force-stops it (launcher pre-start, cleaner, resource manager), so it keeps receiving its notifications. Reads no screen content.
❌ Service disabled: Accessibility settings → Guardian → turn on

Lock Guardian in recent apps (once)

1. Open recent apps (swipe up from the bottom of the screen and hold).

2. Put the lock on the "Guardian" card (depending on the version: drag the card down, or long-press it then Lock).

3. Tap the card to come back here, then press "Done".

⚠️ Never close this card by swiping it up: vivo would force-stop Guardian and its accessibility service would have to be turned on again.

The lock is remembered after "Done", after a reboot and after an update. It is only lost if the app is uninstalled.
